data.body: INVESTIGATION COMPLETE (INTERMEDIATE, opus). Root cause confirmed + panel direction grounded. FIX: new shared predicate rc_diff_is_empty_net in review-coverage-lib.sh [EXEMPT iff >=2 parents AND diff-tree --cc rc==0 AND empty file list; rc1 non-merge/non-empty; rc2 ERROR on diff-tree!=0 -> callers fail closed]. Wire additively+fail-closed into the 3 DD6 shared-predicate consumers (review-coverage-invariant.sh ~149, verify-session-provenance.sh ~419, fp-recovery-audit-sweep.sh) BEFORE the existing unprovenanced/UNREVIEWED fail-close; dispatcher (llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh:493-507) inherits transitively via verify-session-provenance's unprovenanced-shas.txt (NOT a shared-predicate consumer, no edit). Extend DD6 equivalence test + negative controls (content merge, single-parent, octopus-with-content, bad-sha). Built ON the shared lib (one predicate / consumers), NOT parallel, NOT content-hash carry-forward. Classification behavioral score 5 INTERMEDIATE; testing_mode RED. Safeguard edit proceeding under user directive 'complete the remaining major fix' + panel-approved direction.
